class Base {
  protected count = 1;
}
interface BaseView extends Base {}
interface IndirectBase extends BaseView {}
class Derived extends Base {
  read(other: BaseView): number { return other.count; }
  indirect(other: IndirectBase): number { return other.count; }
  readGeneric<T extends BaseView>(other: T): number { return other.count; }
  readIntersection(other: { extra: boolean } & BaseView): number { return other.count; }
}
